newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls four cts/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls four cts/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell by four cents to 553 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Geelong on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mostly cheaper, with 19/21 microns one percent cheaper and 20 micron 1.5 percent cheaper while 25/26 microns were unchanged.
Merino skirtings were mixed with 19/21 microns one percent cheaper and 20 micron generally unchanged while crossbreds were cheaper across the board.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said most demand came from Japan and China with good support from Western Europe.
Of the 22,551 bales on offer, 16.0 percent was passed in.
Sales continues on Thursday in Sydney, Geelong, and Fremantle with about 28,000 bales to be offered.
